summary:
FAIL, on one new finding outside the product: F-DG4-104 (Medium, not mandatory, owner delivery-orchestrator). The round-2 freeze commit 1b8c158 records DG4 as REVIEWING -> REVIEWING in stages.json; the round-1 repair phase was never recorded as FIXING. So validate.mjs --historical --stage DG3, DG2 and DG1 and --pipeline (CI's first job) all exit 1 with 'DG4 illegal transition REVIEWING -> REVIEWING'. With stages.json from the source commit 93a7dd7 all three historical validations pass. stages.json is not in the candidate, so the candidate ID and the product are unaffected. The fix is a stages.json history correction by the orchestrator; after it, the four validations should be re-run. The assignment requires these validations to pass, so I count the finding as blocking.

On the candidate itself I found no defect. All four of my round-1 findings verify CLOSED (verifications sidecar):
- F-DG4-100: probe S with no allowance has zero NO-DENIAL lines over 540 403s by AUD, ADM-only and the outsider; probe D shows all four Finance SoD refusals write one denial; probe E shows the new lookup discloses nothing.
- F-DG4-101: a stale amend or reverse now gets 409 and writes nothing; fresh ETags chain; races have one winner; 0061 admits only an audited version+1 on an approved, corrected validation.
- F-DG4-102: only the DG2 admin cycle remains.
- F-DG4-103: a delegation, delegator role or grant revoked, or the user disabled, in the window refuses decideGate, submitGate and updateGate.

Everything else holds:
- Build, typecheck, lint, format, no-cdn and openapi:lint (652 operations) pass.
- Unit tests pass: 2782 + 259 (2 by-design skips) on Node 22 and 24.
- Integration passes 1953/1953 twice (LANG unset on a SQL_ASCII cluster, and C.UTF-8), migrating 0001 -> 0061.
- The round-1 probes A, B and I re-run unchanged with identical results.
- The module graph is acyclic and the worker is isolated.
- The repair diff weakens nothing.

Disclosed non-zero exits: probe F rev1, probe C rev1 and the first scanner call, each my own probe error, corrected and explained in its check; and the four validator runs (F-DG4-104).

Deviation: the assignment's owner list names implementer roles only; F-DG4-104 is owned by delivery-orchestrator, the only role that may write stages.json, which findings.schema.json allows.
